target_customer: Consumers who want spending aligned with values, using a bank account with ESG data
problem: Shoppers lack actionable environmental, social and governance data about the companies they buy from.
business_model: Consumer fintech account with rewards and perks, likely interchange based

founders.name: Anna Matalon
founders.background_notes: YC page: entrepreneurship, product and design.

founders.name: Jon Sheller
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists Peace Corps Paraguay.

competitors.name: Aspiration
competitors.what: Sustainability focused financial services with consumer app
competitors.traction_then: Founded 2013; described as facing increasing competition in consumer climate solutions

competitors.name: Carbon Zero Financial
competitors.what: Launched an app measuring carbon impact of credit card spending

technical_complexity.rationale: A bank account product needs a banking partner, card program and ESG data aggregation, hard for three people.

defensibility.rationale: ESG data and rewards are licensable and copyable by banks and existing sustainability fintechs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent action.

market_need_then: Consumer climate and ESG fintech drew attention in 2021 per Fortune; no demand metrics for this product were found.

branding.domain_note: purposefinance.com now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page, so the domain was dropped after the company went inactive.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: accelerating the shift to a more transparent economy; keeps it fun with perks and rewards.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared by Purpose Investments, Purpose Financial and Purpose ESG, and no brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Purpose Finance was a three person consumer ESG banking startup in YC Winter 2021 that is listed Inactive and whose domain is for sale. No shutdown statement was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: The 130K YC seed and the March 2021 date rest on CB Insights alone; the same page shows 2 rounds and a dead flag dated 2023-11, unclear. Competitor sources are dated September 2021, six months after the batch start. Domain fetch redirected to a for-sale page and was not followed.
